The model is standing indoors, with a modern and minimalistic background that includes a piece of abstract art on the wall and a woven mat or rug on the floor. The text at the bottom of the post reads: "primalgray.shop Tie Up Pants Sleek, modern pants for any occasion. Limited stock—act now!" This indicates that the pants are available for purchase
